issues.detail: The skill is tied to the Expo and Metro toolchain (expo install, expo-router, app.json, Expo-specific Babel preset), and gives no setup steps for bare React Native CLI projects.

scenarios.name: expo-nativewind-setup-pinned
scenarios.rationale: A pins nativewind@4.2.7 and explicitly warns that unpinned tailwindcss pulls Tailwind 4, and it covers all configs and the -c restart; B omits the 4.2.7 pin and never warns about the unpinned tailwindcss install, though its configs and -c restart are otherwise complete.

scenarios.name: dark-mode-toggle-with-system-option
scenarios.rationale: Both cover app.json, darkMode class (with the setColorScheme throw), setColorScheme with light/dark/system, paired classes and AsyncStorage persistence; B explicitly calls out paired classes (text-black dark:text-white as the rule) and concisely hits every rubric point, while A shows persistence in more detail but is messier (a stray bogus import) and doesn't explicitly stress the paired-class rule.

scenarios.name: debug-classname-not-applying
scenarios.rationale: Both cover the config causes (content globs, preset, global.css, -c restart) and hover/Pressable. B states the hover:/onHoverIn mechanism and mentions remapProps and a wrapper passing style. A gives more setup detail but never mentions onHoverIn, and its third-party advice is only cssInterop.
